lead.headline: 34 of Trump's 45 second-term judges (76%) got no Democratic votes; Biden's 2023-24 judges: 25% got no Republican votes
lead.number: 34 of 45, including all 7 appeals judges, got zero Democratic or independent votes; Biden 32 of 130 (25%); without Collins, Murkowski and Graham, Biden's figure would be 58%
lead.watch_out: Most of the gap is three Republican senators (Collins, Murkowski, Graham), and partisan confirmations are widely covered.
